title: 3.2.4a Lab — Add a Cone
description: Create a Cone with distinct radius and height values — your first Cone in 3D.

steps.title: Create a Cone
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cone = new Cone(0, 0, 0, 0.8, 2)` to create a cone with radius 0.8 and height 2.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Cone section for the constructor order.

steps.title: Give it a color
steps.instructions: Set `cone.color = 'orange'` or any color you like.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the color property.
